description: Eesti geodeetiliste punktide andmekogu is a dataset listed in Data information gateway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Maa- ja Ruumiamet. Eesti geodeetiliste punktide andmekogu (GPA) koosneb digitaalselt peetavast geodeetiliste punktide andmebaasist, mis sisaldab muuhulgas geodeetiliste punktide koordinaate ja kõrguseid ning Maa- ja Ruumiameti arhiivi geodeetilistest materjalidest. Avatud on geodeetiliste punktide veebipõhine andmekogu, kust leiab punktide kohta lisainfona näiteks jooniseid ja fotosid. Coverage: Maa- ja Ruumiamet. The publisher named on the listing is Maa- ja Ruumiamet. Its keywords include geodeesia, ruumiandmed, geodesy, geospatial data, geodeetilised punktid, GPA. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-avaandmete-portaal.
